method: One reference-to-rig transform for the entire front view. Neutral pose, no independent image contain-fitting.
notes: Source anatomy was widened with one built-in imagegen edit; crop dimensions preserve its native aspect at assembly.
Hands have a separate wrist-centered rest correction so sleeve alignment does not lengthen fingers.
Hidden thigh-root overlap changes only the area under the skirt; foot pivots set the standing leg angle.
Torso source PNG, unpainted nails, asymmetric wrist device, face, blink and mouth assets are preserved.
The front reference head is slightly tilted. Artwork contours and folds differ; this is a proportion check, not pixel identity.
